notes: *his* at t008 is added: בִשְׂפָתַיִם carries no suffix, and rule 18's closing sentence leaves a supplied possessive added.
*a man* leaves the article הָ unrepresented, since the ASV writes an indefinite article for the phrase (rule 29).
כֹּל takes *whatsoever* with the construction-supplied copula, as in v. 3, and its לְ is unrepresented under rules 40 and 52.
